info.title: AMU Student Resource Management System
info.description:
## AMU Student Resource Management System API

The **AMU Student Resource Management System** provides high-performance, enterprise-grade backend services for academic content distribution, collaborative sharing, and secure storage management across Students, Teachers, and Administrators.

### Key Capabilities & Architecture Pillars

1. **Enterprise Identity & Auth**:
   - RFC 7519 JSON Web Token (JWT) authentication with refresh token rotation.
   - Self-service email registration with transactional verification links.
   - Secure password reset workflows with time-limited tokens.
   - Role-Based Access Control (`Student`, `Teacher`, `Administrator`).

2. **Hierarchical Content Organization**:
   - Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) folder hierarchies with cyclic reference prevention.
   - Strict per-user storage isolation (`users/{user_id}/{folder}/...`).

3. **Storage Quota & Two-Phase Upload Protocol**:
   - Atomic reservation checking under row-level database locks.
   - Dual backend support: Supabase Cloud Storage and MinIO/S3 object store.
   - Real-time client upload progress tracking with Server-Sent Events (SSE).
   - Automated quota enforcement (1 GiB for Students, 15 GiB for Teachers).

4. **Event-Driven Storage Webhooks**:
   - Supabase Storage Webhook receiver with HMAC secret verification.
   - Automated quota commitment, checksum validation, and private resource creation upon object creation.

5. **Granular Privacy & Sharing Governance**:
   - Resources default to `PRIVATE` to protect student and faculty data.
   - Access grants with fine-grained permissions (`VIEW`, `EDIT`) and instant revocation.
   - Time-limited signed download URLs (15-minute expiry) preventing persistent URL leakage.

6. **High-Performance Search & Observability**:
   - PostgreSQL trigram and full-text tsvector search.
   - OpenTelemetry distributed tracing and structured JSON logging.

post.summary: Phase 1: Reserve storage quota and obtain presigned S3 upload URL
post.description:
Atomically locks user quota, checks available bytes, increments reserved_bytes,
and returns a short-lived presigned PUT URL for direct client-to-storage upload.

post.summary: Phase 2: Finalize upload, verify in storage, and commit quota
post.description:
Inspects S3 object via HeadObject, validates byte length, deducts from reserved
quota, adds to used quota, marks reservation COMPLETED, and registers StorageObject.

post.summary: Cancel a pending upload reservation and release reserved bytes

get.summary: Check real-time upload progress, processing state, and resource ID
get.description:
Returns the live progress percentage (0-100), current status (PENDING, UPLOADING,
PROCESSING, COMPLETED, FAILED), transferred byte counts, and linked resource ID.

patch.summary: Report in-flight byte transmission progress from the frontend
patch.description: Frontend clients uploading directly to storage can report intermediate transfer progress.

get.summary: Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream for real-time upload progress updates
get.description:
Provides an SSE connection (text/event-stream) emitting real-time progress events
until the upload reaches COMPLETED, FAILED, or CANCELLED status.

get.summary: Get current user's storage quota breakdown
get.description: Returns total, used, reserved, and available storage bytes with usage percentage.

get.summary: Generate a presigned GET download URL for a stored object
get.description: Returns a short-lived presigned URL with Content-Disposition headers for downloading.

post.summary: Admin sweeper: Clean up expired reservations and release reserved quota
post.description: Sweeps abandoned upload reservations older than 30 minutes (EC-05.4).

get.summary: List all resources that have been explicitly shared with current user
get.description: Retrieves all academic resources explicitly shared with the authenticated user.

schema.title: Response List Resources Shared With Me Api V1 Resources Shared With Me Get

post.summary: Grant VIEW or EDIT access to a user by email
post.description:
Grants access to a target student or teacher:
- Enforces EC-07.1: Only resource owner or administrator can share.
- Enforces EC-07.2: Cannot share a resource with yourself.
- Enforces EC-07.4: Grantee must be an active registered user.

get.summary: List all active share grants on a resource
get.description: Lists users who have been granted access to this resource (Owner/Admin only).

schema.title: Response List Resource Share Grants Api V1 Resources  Resource Id  Share Get

delete.description:
Revokes access immediately (EC-07.3). Subsequent download or read attempts
by the revoked user will immediately be rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden.

post.summary: Direct multipart file upload into user-segregated folder with privacy defaults
post.description:
Directly uploads file to Supabase storage in user's isolated folder (users/{user_id}/{folder}/...),
enforces storage quota, sets privacy to PRIVATE by default, and registers the resource.

post.summary: Create a new resource (file-backed or link-backed)
post.description:
Creates a new academic resource:
- If student: status=PRIVATE, visibility=PRIVATE (EC-06.1)
- If teacher/admin: status=APPROVED, visibility=DEPARTMENT
- If link: validates with SSRF guard against internal/private IPs (EC-06.2)
- If file: attaches completed upload reservation and links storage object.

get.summary: List accessible resources with optional filters
get.description: Retrieves resources visible to current user (own resources, approved departmental, or public).

schema.title: Response List Resources Api V1 Resources Get

get.summary: Get single resource details by ID
get.description: Retrieves resource with version history. Enforces privacy guard (EC-06.1, EC-06.4).

patch.description: Updates title, description, folder, subject, or visibility (Owner/Admin only).

delete.summary: Delete a resource and release used storage quota
delete.description: Deletes resource, releases used quota for stored files, and cascades versions.

post.summary: Add a new version to an existing resource
post.description:
Creates a new version (version 2, 3...) for an existing resource.
Preserves all previous versions and file assets (EC-06.3).

get.summary: Get download URL or link for a resource asset
get.description:
Generates secure presigned download URL for file or returns safe external URL.
Enforces authorization check (EC-06.4).

post.summary: Supabase Storage Webhook receiver for object upload events
post.description:
Receives automated notifications from Supabase Storage triggers when files are uploaded.
Verifies the webhook secret, transitions the upload reservation to COMPLETED, commits
storage quota atomically, and securely activates the resource.
